notes.title: A Regulation Update
notes.content:
[h1]Regulation 1k[/h1]
Tombstone Tally has reached over 1000 unique players! Thank you to everyone who has submitted bugs or uploaded videos, these help out all the players who try out the game. This update has 2 new maps and lots of small fixes to common problems. Keep a lookout for some suspicious fish on the Beachside map, who knows what terrors they hold back...

[h2]Major Additions[/h2]
Added two new beachside maps.
Added 20 new grave epitaphs.

[h2]AI and Performance[/h2]
Improved AI movement.
Improved AI performance drastically.
Some graphical performance optimizations.

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
Fixed many grave assignments.
Fixed losing mouse while looking at Tally card.
Possibly fixed repeated sounds from shovel impact.
Possibly fixed camera rotating after being hit (if you get this glitch, please let me know!).
Fixed shovel disappearing sometimes.
Fixed players ready mismatch.
Fixed double players in lobby after a game.

notes.title: Patch 1.12 10/19/24
notes.content:
Hey guys, thank you to all the players that have been checking out the game this week! Have you checked out the Arena map yet?

There was an issue with the project files and a lot of the assets had to be reimported for this update. I've fixed some issues that arose due to it, but there's always a chance something escaped detection. If you encounter any weird bugs, please post about it on the discussion page. I've heard there is one bug that results in the camera rotating after being ragdolled, let me know if you encounter that issue!

[h2]Patch notes for 1.12[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added viewing control layouts in options. (Currently no remapping available, sorry!)
[*] Cleaned up flashlight position code.
[*] Fixed zoom in bug on graves.
[*] Fixed even more grave assignments.
[*] Adjusted timings for standing up and being chased.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.1 10/16/24
notes.content:
[h1]Patch notes for version 1.1:[/h1]

[h2]New additions:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Current scores can be checked with the ESC menu.
[*] Improved AI movement.
[*] Improved AI performance.
[*] If you run out of shovels in the map, more will spawn.
[/list]

[h2]Visual fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Ragdolling now shows attached extras.
[*] Various optimization improvements.
[*] Fixed camera clipping.
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed some grave epitaph assignments.
[*] Joining via friends should now always work correctly.
[*] Blackout now notifies when the player is about to win.
[*] AI can be hit before they mark a square.
[*] If you kick bots, server list should be correct after ending game.
[/list]

[h2]Known bugs:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Some hardware configurations may result in the game not starting at all. Still collecting data on this.
[*] If the host returns all players to the lobby there could be a sync issue.
[*] Joining via Steam in certain menus/modes may cause issues.
[*] Flashlights don't sync position exactly correctly.
[*] Returning to lobby after finishing a multiplayer game can have issues with gamepads.
[/list]

notes.title: Update notes for post launch 10/15/24
notes.content:
Thank you for trying out the game! I know there are still a lot of small issues to fix, so feel free to report them in the discussion section. I'll have as many as I can fixed ASAP.

[list]
[*] Shovels correctly work in single player.
[*] Bucket secret cannot obtained via wall-clipping.
[*] Added experimental bot support to multiplayer.
[*] Fixed some AI navigation.
[*] Fixed some grave epitaph assignments.
[*] Fixed achievement tracking for single player.
[/list]
